title: Verenium · care workshop
intro: what would help today? choose a route. notes stay in this tab until you close it. you can save a copy yourself.
review: editorial translation · independent language review pending
activationText: apply the starting profile: Verenium, care route, and one-question view. your notes stay as they are.
applied: starting profile applied in this tab. save the route and settings to use them again.
alias: what would you call your guide?
depth: how much detail feels right today?
careText: one phrase is enough: “what I need right now is…”
careLocal: open the personal map · stays local
careExternal: open the external Google form · English and Russian
formNote: if you submit the form, Google and its owner receive what you write there. notes from this workshop stay here.
orderFields: what is taking up your attention?
what is one step you can take today?
councilLead: question → evidence → different voices → choice → review. note what helped and what needs another look.
councilBoundary: this is a worksheet for thinking together. each person speaks for themselves. it does not call people or AI.
councilFields: what do we know, and what supports it?
what was chosen, who agreed, and when will we review?
setupFirst: if you downloaded the full Verenium bundle, unpack SUTI.os.zip into a new folder.
setupNext: open SUTI.os/vault as a separate vault in Obsidian or as a folder in a Markdown editor.
setupLast: start with «начать.md». you can keep notes without an account or a network connection.
verifyText: in the SUTI.os folder, run python3 install.py --verify-only (Windows: py install.py --verify-only). this command only checks the files.
glossary: Stozhary · words of care and the song of water
glossaryText: soyuzhestvo: two people agreed to work together. sotsvetie: each brings a gift. sozvezdie: the links are visible and anyone can leave. Stozhary: we met again and asked, “who did this help?”
water: vodovol · shall I pour you some water?
wait: tkokh · I’ll wait for your answer.
saveNote: the personal file includes answers hidden by the current level of detail.
saved: keep the file somewhere private. it contains your notes.
invalid: this file is not compatible. your current notes remain in this tab.
principlesText: ask first. distinguish observation from a guess. leave room to decline. silence is not consent. choose a manageable step and check whether it helped. leave others room to tell their own stories.
cues: what would you like to exchange?

what do we know, and how can we check it?
whose views did we hear, and what did we agree on?
